_doc: GA4 + Search Console per edition. Used only when the build runs with --analytics production (env GJ_ANALYTICS=production). Staging builds emit no tag, no meta, no script. The browser also checks location.hostname against production_hosts, so a production build opened on a staging host still sends nothing. gsc_token: paste the google-site-verification content value to also emit the meta tag (DNS TXT verification needs no token here).
